newsitem.title: USA: Judge rules Mass. owes inmates $1 mln in back pay.
newsitem.headline: Judge rules Mass. owes inmates $1 mln in back pay.

text.p: A Massachusetts judge ruled that the state's Department of Corrections owes 2,253 prison inmates an estimated $1 million in back pay for prison work, Boston Globe reported Tuesday.
The prisoners were promised a $0.50 pay hike in 1991 but never received the extra money.

Suffolk County Judge Patrick King said a Department of Corrections regulation on a pay hike was a contract and the state must now make retroactive payments, plus interest, to the inmates, the Globe reported.
A department spokesman told the newspaper Corrections is reviewing King's decision before deciding on an appeal.

He said the $1 million verdict is unlikely to force the department to ask the state legislature to increase its $300 million budget, but it may ask the state Administration and Finance agency to dip into a reserve for court-ordered judgements, according to the newspaper.
